param_input_item.param_description: an integer value: number of innermost frames left out (0 by default).

param_output_item.param_description: an integer: index in st of the frame of the current workspace (1 unless dbup moved it).

description.p: dbstack displays the file names and line numbers of the function calls.
dbstack('-completenames') displays the full file names.
A local function is displayed as file>local_function, the form dbstop and which take; the name field of the output holds the function name alone.
The frame of the current workspace is marked with >. Built-in functions have no frame.

example_item.example_item_description: Creates a myfun.m and calls it.

history_item.history_description: Local functions displayed as file>local_function, one line per call: In name (line n); omit counts the frames shown; current frame marked; output I.
